en.description: Wenzhang Du — Independent researcher exploring LLM safety, trustworthy AI, AI agent evaluation, model auditing, and robust empirical machine learning.
heroStatement: I work to close the gaps.
en.heroIntro: As AI accelerates research, rigorous validation needs to keep pace. I work to uncover blind spots, test assumptions, and address hidden failures through model auditing, statistical evaluation, and empirical research.
en.heroNote: B.Eng. in Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence
en.degree: B.Eng. in Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence
en.aboutLead: My research starts with a simple question: how do we know an AI system is behaving reliably?
aboutParagraphs: I am an independent researcher and a B.Eng. graduate of the International College at Mahanakorn University of Technology. My interests center on LLM safety, trustworthy AI, AI agent evaluation, and rigorous empirical machine learning.

I am interested in practical ways to uncover failure cases, test prompt and instruction robustness, detect hallucinations and risk, and compare models with statistical care. My background also spans efficient deep learning, computer vision, and remote sensing.
For graduate research, I hope to build evaluation frameworks that make AI system behavior easier to test, compare, and improve.
en.researchIntro: From understanding failure to measuring progress and putting reliable learning into practice.

zh.aboutTitle:
提出更好的问题，
寻找更可靠的答案。
zh.aboutLead: 我的研究始于一个朴素的问题：我们如何知道一个人工智能系统的行为是可靠的？
aboutParagraphs: 我是一名独立研究者，毕业于泰国马汉科理工大学国际学院，获得计算机工程与人工智能专业工学学士学位。我的研究兴趣集中于大语言模型安全、可信人工智能、智能体评估与严谨的实证机器学习。
我关注实用的评估方法，包括失效案例审计、提示与指令鲁棒性、幻觉与风险检测，以及具有统计可靠性的模型比较。我的研究背景也涵盖高效深度学习、计算机视觉和遥感。
在未来的研究生阶段，我希望构建评估框架，让人工智能系统的行为更容易被测试、比较与改进。
